deck.title: Benefits of using a Local Area Network (LAN)

front_blocks.md: Give four benefits of using a local area network.

back_blocks.md: Users can **share peripherals** such as printers, have **shared access to the internet**, **access their files from any computer** on the network, **communicate more easily**, **share files and folders**, use servers for **centralised backups, updates and security**, and use **media streaming**.

cards.front_md: Give four benefits of using a local area network.
cards.back_md: Users can **share peripherals** such as printers, have **shared access to the internet**, **access their files from any computer** on the network, **communicate more easily**, **share files and folders**, use servers for **centralised backups, updates and security**, and use **media streaming**.

front_blocks.md: Why is sharing peripherals on a LAN a benefit?

back_blocks.md: Sharing peripherals **reduces the cost and time** needed to access a central one, rather than buying a device for every user.

cards.front_md: Why is sharing peripherals on a LAN a benefit?
cards.back_md: Sharing peripherals **reduces the cost and time** needed to access a central one, rather than buying a device for every user.

front_blocks.md: Why is sharing data on a LAN a benefit?

back_blocks.md: Shared data allows **easier collaboration** between users.

cards.front_md: Why is sharing data on a LAN a benefit?
cards.back_md: Shared data allows **easier collaboration** between users.

front_blocks.md: What does flexible access on a LAN allow a user to do?

back_blocks.md: Flexible access allows **hot desking**, because users can access their files from **any computer on the network**.

cards.front_md: What does flexible access on a LAN allow a user to do?
cards.back_md: Flexible access allows **hot desking**, because users can access their files from **any computer on the network**.

front_blocks.md: Why is shared access to the internet a benefit of a LAN?

back_blocks.md: It **reduces the need for individual connectivity** for every device.

cards.front_md: Why is shared access to the internet a benefit of a LAN?
cards.back_md: It **reduces the need for individual connectivity** for every device.

front_blocks.md: What three things can a server provide centrally on a LAN?

back_blocks.md: A server can provide centralised **backups**, **updates** and **security**.

cards.front_md: What three things can a server provide centrally on a LAN?
cards.back_md: A server can provide centralised **backups**, **updates** and **security**.

front_blocks.md: Servers and switches can provide a central point of <u>**            **</u>, so users cannot complete tasks if one fails.

back_blocks.md: Servers and switches can provide a central point of **failure**, so users cannot complete tasks if one fails.

cards.front_md: Servers and switches can provide a central point of <u>**            **</u>, so users cannot complete tasks if one fails.
cards.back_md: Servers and switches can provide a central point of **failure**, so users cannot complete tasks if one fails.

front_blocks.md: Give two security drawbacks of using a LAN.

back_blocks.md: There is an **increased security risk to data**, and **malicious software can infiltrate the network** and render it unusable.

cards.front_md: Give two security drawbacks of using a LAN.
cards.back_md: There is an **increased security risk to data**, and **malicious software can infiltrate the network** and render it unusable.

front_blocks.md: What factors can affect the performance of a LAN?

back_blocks.md: Performance is affected by the **number of users** and the **amount of data on the network at one time**.

cards.front_md: What factors can affect the performance of a LAN?
cards.back_md: Performance is affected by the **number of users** and the **amount of data on the network at one time**.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
Connecting computers on a LAN removes the security risk to data.

back_blocks.md: **False.**
A LAN brings an **increased security risk to data**, because malicious software can spread across the network.

cards.front_md:
**True or False?**

Connecting computers on a LAN removes the security risk to data.
cards.back_md:
**False.**

A LAN brings an **increased security risk to data**, because malicious software can spread across the network.

front_blocks.md: Name two kinds of media a LAN can be used to stream.

back_blocks.md: A LAN can stream **movies**, **music** and **gaming** content.

cards.front_md: Name two kinds of media a LAN can be used to stream.
cards.back_md: A LAN can stream **movies**, **music** and **gaming** content.

front_blocks.md: Define **peer-to-peer network**.

back_blocks.md: A peer-to-peer network is a network with **no server providing services**, where every computer is **equal to all other computers**.

cards.front_md: Define **peer-to-peer network**.
cards.back_md: A peer-to-peer network is a network with **no server providing services**, where every computer is **equal to all other computers**.

front_blocks.md: Name three things each peer on a peer-to-peer network is responsible for.

back_blocks.md: Each peer **provides access to its own files** and is responsible for its **own backups** and its **own security**, and often has its **own printer attached**.

cards.front_md: Name three things each peer on a peer-to-peer network is responsible for.
cards.back_md: Each peer **provides access to its own files** and is responsible for its **own backups** and its **own security**, and often has its **own printer attached**.

front_blocks.md: Give three advantages of a peer-to-peer network.

back_blocks.md: It is **very easy to set up and maintain**, **very cheap** because there is no expensive hardware to purchase, and **no specialist knowledge or staff** are required to run it.

cards.front_md: Give three advantages of a peer-to-peer network.
cards.back_md: It is **very easy to set up and maintain**, **very cheap** because there is no expensive hardware to purchase, and **no specialist knowledge or staff** are required to run it.

front_blocks.md: Give three disadvantages of a peer-to-peer network.

back_blocks.md: Users must **manage their own backups** and **their own software updates**, and the network **can be less secure**.

cards.front_md: Give three disadvantages of a peer-to-peer network.
cards.back_md: Users must **manage their own backups** and **their own software updates**, and the network **can be less secure**.

front_blocks.md: Why does a lack of centralised backup on a peer-to-peer network cost more?

back_blocks.md: **Each client has to be backed up separately**, so **individual backup devices** are needed on every device.

cards.front_md: Why does a lack of centralised backup on a peer-to-peer network cost more?
cards.back_md: **Each client has to be backed up separately**, so **individual backup devices** are needed on every device.

front_blocks.md: Why can users not hot-desk on a peer-to-peer network?

back_blocks.md: There are **no roaming profiles**, so a user's files and settings do not follow them to another machine.

cards.front_md: Why can users not hot-desk on a peer-to-peer network?
cards.back_md: There are **no roaming profiles**, so a user's files and settings do not follow them to another machine.

front_blocks.md: Define **client-server network**.

back_blocks.md: A client-server network is a network that **uses a server**, with clients connecting to it via a **switch**.

cards.front_md: Define **client-server network**.
cards.back_md: A client-server network is a network that **uses a server**, with clients connecting to it via a **switch**.

front_blocks.md: Name four single purposes a server on a client-server network might have.

back_blocks.md: A server might **manage access to the internet**, **manage printing**, **provide email services**, **provide backups** or **control security**.

cards.front_md: Name four single purposes a server on a client-server network might have.
cards.back_md: A server might **manage access to the internet**, **manage printing**, **provide email services**, **provide backups** or **control security**.

front_blocks.md: How does a server compare with the client machines on the network?

back_blocks.md: Servers are often **more powerful** than the client machines, are seen as **more significant**, and can require **specialist hardware and software**.

cards.front_md: How does a server compare with the client machines on the network?
cards.back_md: Servers are often **more powerful** than the client machines, are seen as **more significant**, and can require **specialist hardware and software**.

front_blocks.md: Give three advantages of a client-server network.

back_blocks.md: **Backups are easier** because they are done from one central point, **updating and installing software can be done centrally** rather than on each machine, and **security of files can be managed easily**.

cards.front_md: Give three advantages of a client-server network.
cards.back_md: **Backups are easier** because they are done from one central point, **updating and installing software can be done centrally** rather than on each machine, and **security of files can be managed easily**.

front_blocks.md: A server can be a single point of <u>**            **</u>, meaning all users would lose access to the network if it fails.

back_blocks.md: A server can be a single point of **failure**, meaning all users would lose access to the network if it fails.

cards.front_md: A server can be a single point of <u>**            **</u>, meaning all users would lose access to the network if it fails.
cards.back_md: A server can be a single point of **failure**, meaning all users would lose access to the network if it fails.

front_blocks.md: Give two cost-related disadvantages of a client-server network.

back_blocks.md: Servers can be **expensive to purchase, set up and maintain**, and a **specialist network manager** is required because servers need specialist IT knowledge.

cards.front_md: Give two cost-related disadvantages of a client-server network.
cards.back_md: Servers can be **expensive to purchase, set up and maintain**, and a **specialist network manager** is required because servers need specialist IT knowledge.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
Most schools and companies use a peer-to-peer network model.

back_blocks.md: **False.**
Most companies, organisations and schools use a **client-server** model; it is most **homes** that use a peer-to-peer model.
